model: Smart Wall Switch H1 EU (With Neutral, Single Rocker) (WS-EUK03)
name: Aqara Wall Switch H1 (EU)

radios.note: Zigbee 3.0. The with-neutral version also acts as a Zigbee router.

matter.note: CSA lists only Zigbee 3.0 for this switch. Aqara says Matter comes through a Matter-capable Aqara hub, not from the switch itself, so the switch is not Matter-certified on its own.

apple_home.note: Aqara's with-neutral page lists HomeKit, with an Aqara hub (e.g. G2H, M1S, M2) as the bridge.

google_home.note: Aqara's with-neutral page lists Google, through an Aqara hub.

alexa.note: Aqara's with-neutral page lists Alexa, through an Aqara hub.

smartthings.note: No Aqara page found that names SmartThings for this switch.

home_assistant.note: Reachable through Aqara's Matter bridge hubs or a Zigbee coordinator, but no official source was confirmed.

hubRequired.note: Aqara's manual says app control, timers and power statistics work after binding to an Aqara hub; the hub is sold separately.

localControl.note: Not stated in the sources found. The rocker works as a normal switch when the network is down.

switchForm.note: Replaces the switch in 86 mm square or round European wall boxes (85.8 x 86 x 37.55 mm).

dimmer.note: On/off switch, 8 A resistive load at 100-250 V.

neutralRequired.note: With-neutral version; wiring uses L, N and L1 terminals.

gangs.note: Single rocker version; the double rocker is a separate model (WS-EUK04).

summary: The Aqara Smart Wall Switch H1 EU with neutral and a single rocker replaces your wall switch in an 86 mm or round EU box. It uses Zigbee 3.0, adds power monitoring and overload protection, and acts as a Zigbee router. It needs an Aqara hub, which then links it to Apple Home, Alexa and Google Home.
caveats: Needs an Aqara Zigbee 3.0 hub; the switch alone does not connect to Wi-Fi or Matter.
Requires a neutral wire; Aqara sells a separate no-neutral H1 version.
Wrong wiring can burn out the switch; Aqara advises an electrician if unsure.
